google-services-mcp.copy: 134 tools across 11 Google services — Gmail, Calendar, Meet, Drive, Contacts, Tasks, Sheets, Docs, Slides, YouTube, and Forms — with multi-account OAuth, so an agent works against real user data.

vscode-mcp-server.copy: 54 VS Code tools over SSE — debugger, integrated terminal, language servers, file operations, and command execution — so an agent can read, write, and debug a real workspace.

pcbway-mcp-server.copy: 16 tools over the PCBWay Partner API — instant PCB and SMT assembly quotes, order lifecycle (place, confirm, cancel, track), shipping costs, and account balance.

opencode-model-failover.copy: Moves a session to the next healthy model in a chain you define when a provider rate-limits, times out, or fails — with retryable-only filtering, cooldowns, and no runtime dependencies.

opencode-rtk-plugin.copy: Routes every shell command through rtk so command output reaches the model in compressed form. The upstream project reports 60–90% fewer tokens on common dev commands.

opencode-media-panel.copy: Plays GIFs and video inside the terminal UI, in a session panel — media stays with the work instead of in another window.
